name: Input Precision
description: Registers clicks at their real timestamp on the 240 TPS physics clock, even at 60 or 90 FPS.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn precise input on or off.

poll-rate.name: Poll Rate (Hz)
poll-rate.description: How often the input thread checks your keys and mouse. 1000 is plenty; higher uses more CPU.

mouse.name: Capture Mouse Clicks
mouse.description: Treat left mouse button as jump.
